item.title: Saving the universe with a cafeteria lady: Inside the Mecha Force Tango RPG
item.description: From 40k grimdark to neon mechs. Oddvoid Productions discusses Mecha Force Tango, their new anime-inspired RPG where support staff save the world.

item.title: Robin D. Laws returns to drama with Page Turners, a duet RPG from Pelgrane Press
item.description: Pelgrane Press has announced release dates for Page Turners, a new duet RPG from Robin D. Laws designed for one player and one GM.

item.title: Routinely Itemised: RPG #343
item.description: Matt Mercer steps back from DMing due to burnout, Steve Dee passes away and Leon Barillaro joins Wizards of the Coast. Plus news on the Nancy Drew RPG and Conpulsion.

item.title: Watch the full trailer for horror comedy classic remake of ‘The ‘Burbs’ series
item.description: Peacock has released the full trailer for its new horror comedy series The 'Burbs - a remake of the classic movie that starred Tom Hanks and Bruce Dern.

item.title: New Tomb Raider live-action series set to be ‘something special’ according to Sophie Turner
item.description: The build up for the new live-action series of Tomb Raider is causing fans to take serious notice, with star Sophie Turner having recently spoken about her preparation for the role - which starts filming this month!

item.title: First look at Starfinder: Afterlight combat and celebrity voice cast
item.description: Discover the tactical combat and branching narrative of Starfinder: Afterlight as the first public demo is announced for later this year.

item.title: Scotland’s oldest roleplaying convention announces 2026 dates and “On Top of the World” theme
item.description: Conpulsion 2026 returns to Edinburgh this April with a focus on diversity and accessibility in roleplaying games.

item.title: Audio EXP Podcast: #316 – Woosh
item.description: Is LEGO's Smart Bricks technology a boost for engineering or a threat to imagination? Join the conversation alongside news on Phoebe Waller-Bridge's Tomb Raider project, Goodman Games bundles, and why Arthur Morgan's voice is perfect for the new Starfinder: Afterlight game.

item.title: Shoot to thrill? Marsdice offers bullet dice you can actually fire
item.description: A look at the Marsdice bullet dice Kickstarter which features a spring-loaded launcher, fidget spinner mechanics and the correct spelling of Honour.
